I replied to Pree in her #central-team thread. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date. Nothing she can see mentions it: not #central-team and not the public files, which have no Brackenwater account records at all.

I didn't search other channels or private files for her, because those are outside what she can see herself.
